hook.name: ToyhoodFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for ETH/token pools. Charges fees (1%–6.2%) on buys via beforeSwap delta (ETH input) and on sells via afterSwap delta (ETH output), with the fee scaling between a base and max rate based on tick movement from the previous swap. Fees are sent directly to a per-pool fee recipient; only exact-input swaps are permitted.
